documents.ctaHeading: Ready to Become Part of the MSC Family?
documents.ctaText: Your journey of faith, fellowship, and purpose starts here. We would love to welcome you, help you connect, and walk alongside you as you grow in Christ.
documents.journeyHeading: From Your First Visit to Finding Your *Place*
documents.journeyIntro: Whether you’re visiting for the first time or looking for a church family, we want you to feel welcomed, supported, and connected. Our membership journey is designed to help you discover Mercy Seat Chapel, grow in your relationship with Christ, and find meaningful ways to belong and serve.

journeySteps.label: Meet
journeySteps.text: Your journey begins with a warm welcome. Our Welcome & Follow-Up Team is here to connect with you, answer your questions, introduce you to church activities, and help you feel at home.
journeySteps.title: You’re Welcome Here

journeySteps.label: Decide
journeySteps.text: As you get to know our church family, we invite you to learn more about our vision, values, and membership opportunities, helping you prayerfully decide whether Mercy Seat Chapel is where you would like to grow.
journeySteps.title: Take the Next Step

journeySteps.label: Learn
journeySteps.text: Our monthly membership classes introduce you to the church’s beliefs, vision, ministries, and opportunities for spiritual growth. You’ll also learn about SoulCare and the different ways we support our members.
journeySteps.title: Discover Who We Are

journeySteps.label: Connect
journeySteps.text: Through the SoulCare Directorate, we help you connect with a fellowship group or ministry community where you can build friendships, receive encouragement, and grow alongside others.
journeySteps.title: Find Your Community

journeySteps.label: Serve
journeySteps.text: Everyone has something valuable to contribute. We encourage members interested in serving to explore ministry opportunities, receive relevant training, and develop their gifts through pathways such as the Workers Academy.
journeySteps.title: Discover Your Gifts

journeySteps.label: Celebrate
journeySteps.text: We celebrate every step of your spiritual journey, from finding a church family to becoming actively involved in ministry. Together, we continue growing in faith, building relationships, and making a difference for Christ.
journeySteps.title: Grow and Thrive Together

pillars.subtitle: Building a Caring Church Family
pillars.text: We strengthen relationships through genuine fellowship, prayer, encouragement, celebrating special moments, and supporting one another through life’s different seasons. Through our ministries and departments, we create opportunities for everyone to experience a true sense of belonging.
pillars.title: Bonding

pillars.subtitle: Sharing the Message of Hope
pillars.text: We extend our reach through personal evangelism, community outreach, digital media, and creative communication. By sharing our faith, church activities, and testimonies, we invite more people to experience the love of Christ and become part of our church family.
pillars.title: Visibility & Outreach

pillars.subtitle: Helping Everyone Find Their Place
pillars.text: We believe everyone should have the opportunity to belong, grow, and contribute. Through membership classes, ministry groups, training, and leadership development, we help visitors and members discover meaningful connections and opportunities to serve.
pillars.title: Integration

pillars.subtitle: Creating Opportunities for Transformation
pillars.text: Our worship services, teaching programs, conferences, youth gatherings, family events, empowerment initiatives, and community outreach activities provide opportunities to deepen faith, strengthen relationships, discover purpose, and make a difference.
pillars.title: Programs

documents.pillarsIntro: At Mercy Seat Chapel, growth is about more than numbers. It is about building lasting relationships, reaching new people, helping everyone find a place to belong, and creating opportunities for spiritual transformation. Our approach to growth is anchored in four pillars.

values.text: Jesus Christ is at the heart of everything we do. Through worship, prayer, and biblical teaching, we seek to honour Him, reflect His love, and live according to His Word.
values.title: Christ-Centered

values.text: We are committed to helping people grow into mature followers of Christ through purposeful teaching, mentorship, spiritual development, and opportunities to put their faith into action.
values.title: Intentional Discipleship

values.text: We believe church is more than a gathering; it is a spiritual family. We cultivate meaningful relationships built on love, unity, encouragement, accountability, and genuine care for one another.
values.title: Covenant Family Fellowship

values.text: We believe everyone has gifts, talents, and resources entrusted to them by God. We encourage faithful stewardship and joyful service, empowering individuals to contribute meaningfully to the church and wider community.
values.title: Stewardship & Service

values.text: We are called to share the Gospel and demonstrate Christ’s love beyond the walls of the church through evangelism, compassion, community engagement, and practical acts of service.
values.title: Mission & Outreach

documents.visionHeading: Rooted in Christ. Growing in Faith. Serving with *Purpose*.
documents.visionIntro: At Mercy Seat Chapel, our vision is to build a Christ-centered family where people encounter God’s mercy and grace, grow as disciples, develop meaningful relationships, and discover their purpose in serving God and others. Five foundational values guide who we are and everything we do.

children.text: The Mercy Seat Chapel Music Department, as one body unified in spirit and with a heart of purity, purpose to glorify God, to humbly serve Him in a spirit of excellence as ministers of music, hope, and agape love… To lead others into His divine presence through Thanksgiving, Praise Worship, and Singing Hymns.
Our mission
To inspire, encourage, train, and direct those whom God has called into the music ministry with a spirit of service, excellence, sensitivity, purity, humility, and strength.

The accomplishment of this purpose does not happen as a result of well-trained ears, balanced voicing, or even an energetic stage presence. Instead, true worship leading must be a supernatural extension of our love relationship with Christ (Matthew 22:37-38).

body.text: Sing to the Lord a new song, for He has done marvelous things… Shout for joy to the Lord, all the earth, burst into jubilant song with music… shout for joy before the Lord, the King.

children.text: The Drama team of Mercy Seat Chapel is a department that seeks to minister the word of God through acting. The use of skits which tend to resonate more is a powerful tool for reminding and teaching ourselves the timeless word of God. This department is a strong back up to the Pastor and leadership of the church in helping to de-fragment the “word for now” into easy understandable and interesting graphic images that will sit well with the congregation. This helps the message to sink in deeper thereby ministering more effectively the word of God to people.

The trend of music and movies in the global world has become very appealing to many and in changing with the times to be as flexible as possible, we are a department that is also looking into ways to make our skits of various types; live, recorded etc to diversify the background and generate more interest among the congregation doing all these without losing the potency of the message being passed across which is always based on the word of God.

The ministry gives expression to the creative abilities of workers who are talented in drama through acting, script writing etc. It is a relatively new and small-sized department in terms of constitution within the church but we are truly grateful for the immense impact that the Lord has used us for and greater works that He will do through us in Jesus name.

children.text: The adopted name for the Evangelism Department at Mercy Seat Chapel, Gaithersburg, Maryland is “The Pillars of Hope”. The bible says “But those who hope in the Lord will renew their strength; they will soar on wings like eagles; they will run and not grow weary, they will walk and not be faint” (Isaiah 40:31). The Bible also makes us understand that evangelism is the bedrock of Christianity, and soul winning is the heartbeat of God. As we learn from the scriptures, Our God does not want anyone to perish but everyone to come to repentance (2 Pet 3:9). He sent his son into the world to live a sinless life and die on the cross for us; (John 3:16) “For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life”.
The Evangelism Department is made up of a Spiritual Leader, The Head and the Assistant Head of Department, the Secretary and a team of very loving and dedicated members and volunteers.
Purpose
To expand our reach in touching and affecting the lives of many in our community, i.e. Gaithersburg, Rockville, Montgomery Village, Germantown, Frederick and beyond.
To effect numerical, spiritual growth and the overall strength of our church
One on One Evangelism (at malls and public places, as well as door to door campaigns)
Outdoor events and activities
Tracts, Flyers, Newsletters and Circulars
Dinner, Lunch and Breakfast events
Visitation to homeless shelters, group homes, nursing homes, correctional facilities etc.
To liaise with other groups (i.e. Mercy For Many, the follow up dept etc) to promote soul winning.

cards.text: To spread the good news of Hope and Salvation, with the view of winning many souls into the Kingdom of God.
cards.title: Our Vision

cards.text: To emphasize the importance of soul winning in our church, and to encourage the participation of all church members in carrying out group and individual soul winning activities. “The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life; and he that winneth souls is wise.” (Prov. 11:30)
cards.title: Goal

children.text: The diversity of the temporal activities of the Church requires IT professionals to have flexible service offerings. We try to use industry-based applications and services to minimize our IT resource requirements, avoiding additional human resources costs and eliminating waste so as not to overburden the church wallet. We rely on members’ innovative and online sources. Managing IT at the Church is challenging due to diversity, scope, language requirements, and uses multiple vendors.

We use industry best practices to ensure that we use resources effectively and efficiently. We use diverse software development methodologies, such as Ustream and Easy-worship, to meet the needs of our Video Streaming. We install, monitor, troubleshoot, implement and run all IT related including Networking, systems and video. IT Department is a core backbone of the church because we inter-relate with all other departments.

The blessings of the gospel are now more accessible to an ever-broadening audience over a growing number of media. Information technology relieves some of the administrative burdens of our Pastorate and leaders, who can then focus more time on ministering to member needs. To meet the needs of a diverse global Church, we are constantly striving to effectively manage our unique technology mix.

children.text: Building stronger marriages through biblical guidance, meaningful communication, and compassionate support for couples and families.

The Multimedia Department of Mercy Seat Chapel serves the ministry by capturing, producing and sharing the message of the Gospel through sound, video, photography and graphics. Every Sunday Service, Bible Study and special program is streamed live, so that members and friends who cannot be with us in person can still worship with us online.
The team operates cameras, sound and projection during services, records and edits sermons for our
YouTube channel
, captures moments from church life and outreaches, and designs the flyers and visuals that announce our events.
If you have a gift or interest in photography, video, sound, graphic design or social media, there is a place for you on the Multimedia team. No experience is required. We will train you.

children.text: Mercy Seat Chapel Teen Ministry main purpose is to ground our young teenagers in the way of the Lord, mold new leaders and help bring out the talents that God has placed in them.

Teenagers nowadays are faced with many challenges and temptations that can easily sway them into the sinful ways of the world. The Teen Ministry focuses on practical day to day issues that teenagers encounter such as, peer pressure, obeying their parents, drugs, relationships, self-control, making the right decisions, self esteem in conjunction with providing Biblical principles on how to deal with these issues.

It is the leadership desire to provide dynamic ways in teaching the Word of God. They can range from open discussions, group work, skits, Bible teachings, role play and more. The Teen Ministry has different activities throughout the year to encourage unity and fellowship. Activities consist of, fundraising, trips (Six Flags, bowling, laser tag), outreach programs, food drives, movie nights and many more!
The ministry is growing and is looking for more young vibrant teens to join us as we take a stand for our Lord Jesus Christ.

children.text: The mission of the Empowerment Ministry is to seek and connect Mercy Seat family members to educational, job, professional, business and networking opportunities. The ministry will be a conduit for disseminating information to church members who have needs in any of the areas mentioned.
Career and Job Opportunities

The team will search and match church members with available job openings in the metro area. We will also be responsible for ensuring that every member is prepared for job interviews by reviewing résumés and interview role playing. There will be a one-on-one relationship between each team member and the job candidate.
Business Opportunities

The team will play an advisory and supportive role in helping our members looking to start their own business. The team will organize workshops and provide guidance and assistance to members. The team will inform business owners any opportunities that they know will benefit members.
Networking Opportunities

Team members through our personal associations outside the church, will connect our family members with old contacts, friends and associates who are able to help our members with whatever need they may have. This need may include but not limited to access to financial assistance for real estate purchase, access to venture capital, transferring our children to a private school where they have waiting list, referral to private physicians or doctors where they have no new patient intake.

children.text: The FundaMENtals, the men’s ministry branch of Mercy Seat Chapel, was driven by a vision to bring men together for a noble purpose encompassing service, spiritual growth, empowerment, and positive community influence. The name of this group draws inspiration from the concept of foundational principles.

Combining the attributes of capability, intelligence, strength, and steadfastness embodies the essence of being a “FundaMENtal.” This term encapsulates the notion that men assuming this role should possess qualities that are capable, intelligent, strong, and resolute. Essentially, men embracing the role of FundaMENtals, whether within their families, the church, or the broader community, are called to boldly position themselves for personal growth and community impact. The central message advocated by this group is that the men of Mercy Seat Chapel embody the essence of “The FundaMENtals.”

children.text: The Pillars of Mercy, the women’s ministry-arm of Mercy Seat Chapel, was established with a vision of bringing women together for a godly purpose that includes service, edification for spiritual growth, empowerment, and positive influence in the community.

The group’s name stems from key words from Prov 31:10 and 16, and Heb 4:16. Parts of Prov 31:10 and 16 say “A capable, intelligent, and virtuous woman…, girds herself with strength [spiritual, mental, and physical fitness for her God-given task] and makes her arms strong and firm…” Hebrews 4:16, another very descriptive verse, states “Let us then fearlessly and confidently and boldly draw near to the throne of grace (the throne of God’s unmerited favor to us sinners), that we may receive mercy [for our failures] and find grace to help in good time for every need [appropriate help and well-timed help, coming just when we need it]”.

Put together the words capable, intelligent, strong, and firm, incites another word: “Pillar”. In other words, a woman, who plays the role of a pillar, needs to be capable, intelligent, strong, and firm. As Pillars in the home, church, and community at large, women need to approach God’s presence boldly to receive mercy, and find grace to accomplish their God-given purposes. This group propagates that Mercy Seat Chapel’s women are “Pillars of Mercy”!

children.text: REVIVE is an integral part of the body of Mercy Seat Chapel that focuses on young adults singles.
We provide a safe place where young adults can serve freely, train leaders, learn and grow in Christ, learn humility in God, self respect and self worth.

We also focus on those who are just entering into their youthfulness and make the church a homely atmosphere for them to worship and serve and also offer various assistance to them that can help evolve their personal lives.
REVIVE consists of a demographic of single youths from the age of 18 to 29.

children.text: The joy of Christmas is almost incomplete for the kids without gifts, which sometimes are not affordable to all parents during that season. Mercy Seat Chapel bridges this gap through the Angel Treat to plant smiles on the faces of so many children within the community.

The program creates a memorable Christmas event for kids from Age 0-12, with age-appropriate gifts for every child to go home with. A well-lit and beautiful Christmas scenery that recreates the Christmas story, gives a funfair ambience and a handshake with Santa to complete the package. This also gives the church an opportunity to spread the love of Jesus as the reason for the season through tracts or the word of mouth.
This program has attended to as many as 400 children in one event and has been running for almost a decade.

children.text: Mercy Seat Chapel has over the years partnered with Interfaith Works to cater for the feeding of the residents at the Homeless shelter in Rockville once in a month. This visit usually includes a time of fellowship, sharing the word, praises and prayer. The residents are served after the session and it is always fulfilling to see them receive the meals with love and gratitude.

There is also a monthly visit to the Montgomery Nursing Home to share fellowship and give hope to the hopeless through the word of God and prayers. Special events are also planned for Easter and Christmas to give them an opportunity to feel the joy and warmth of the season. The Christmas program also includes sharing of Christmas gifts.
The Church also attends to other homes on request and ensures that every contact both the residents and the staff are touched with the love of God.

children.text: Through the Mercy For Many Foundation, Mercy Seat Chapel makes a difference by sponsoring needs of orphanages around the world.

Our support helps provide food, clothing, school supplies and other essentials for children who have lost the care of their parents, so that they can grow up knowing they are seen, valued and loved by God. As James 1:27 reminds us, caring for orphans in their distress is at the heart of pure religion.
Members and friends of the church can partner with this outreach through giving and donations of needed items. Contact the church office to learn about current needs.

documents.cardText: Making a difference by sponsoring needs of orphanages around the world.

children.text: Thanksgiving is a season of gratitude, but for many families in our community it can also be a season of need. Through the Annual Turkey Drive, Mercy Seat Chapel shares the blessing of a Thanksgiving meal with families across Gaithersburg and the surrounding communities.

Each year, members and friends of the church come together to give, pack and distribute turkeys and holiday food items to families, seniors and neighbours who could use a helping hand. Every gift is shared with a smile, a word of encouragement and the love of Jesus Christ.
You can be part of the Turkey Drive by giving towards the outreach, volunteering on distribution day, or letting us know about a family who would be blessed by a Thanksgiving meal.
